propositions: When an inbound external user (e.g., Jira assignee) with no local mapping is encountered, a placeholder identity must be created atomically with a 'placeholder' tag, keyed on the provider's stable external_id, storing the raw display_name.

Re-running ensure_identity_for with the same (provider, external_id) must return the existing identity id and not create a duplicate, even if supplied with a different display_name that upgrades the title in place.
ensure_identity_for performs resolve-first (checking for existing mapping) before minting, and optionally upgrades a placeholder identity's display_name if a non-empty, differing name is provided.

Inbound Jira assignee fields containing an accountId and displayName must be resolved through ensure_identity_for to mint or reuse a placeholder identity, with best-effort handling of missing accountId (falling back to name-only behavior without failing the inbound apply).

The placeholder-to-real upgrade path allows removing the 'placeholder' tag or enriching the identity (email/keys) while preserving the same identity id, reused by subsequent resolve calls keyed on external_id.
